done_when: The fix-size limit (the commit hook and close) doesn't count files whose content is exactly what forge sync writes for this repo; any other change to them, and every other file, still counts. A command-level test commits an upgrade fix whose only code changes are forge sync's output (accepted without an allowance) and one that also edits a synced file by hand beyond sync's output (counted).
why: An upgrade fix can't commit without the owner's allowance because forge sync's own output (host hooks, skills and eleven subagent roles per tool) counts toward the five-code-file fix limit
